paper.tip: Keep it dry and clean. Flatten boxes and sell to a junk shop.

plastic.tip: Rinse bottles and containers and sell clean PET. Sachets and thin wrappers are usually residual: rinse, dry and bundle them.

glass.tip: Rinse bottles and keep them whole. Wrap broken glass before throwing it away.

metal.tip: Rinse cans and crush them to save space. Metals fetch the best price at junk shops.

electronics.tip: Do not throw in regular trash. Bring batteries and e-waste to a collection point.

organic.tip: Food scraps and peels can be composted. Keep them separate from dry waste.
